title: Neon Wolf in Crystal Orb
description: A vibrant green wolf with glowing white eyes and open muzzle howls upward from inside a transparent crystal sphere. The wolf is surrounded by floating purple and pink ribbons, yellow lightning bolts, and glowing purple pixel fragments against a dark cosmic background.
prompt: A luminous neon green wolf with bright white glowing eyes and open howling mouth is trapped inside a large transparent crystal orb. Purple and magenta ribbons swirl around the wolf along with bright yellow lightning bolts and floating purple pixel fragments. The wolf's fur is electric green with sharp highlights. Dark cosmic background with subtle colorful particles, dramatic lighting, vibrant digital painting style.
